expectation: A real project workflow (this repository's own maintenance checks: scripts/validate.py and scripts/build_ecosystem.py --check on a git-archive snapshot of HEAD, plus one bounded real model step: codex exec judging the validate output) is triggered by the native `dagu scheduler` from a one-shot cron schedule under pinned Dagu 2.16.6 (sha256 20de7ae9...), stopped with `dagu stop` while its finalize step waits, then recovered with `dagu retry --run-id <same> --step finalize`. Expect scheduler-created run, aborted -> succeeded under one run id, the checkpoint (validate + model) executed exactly once, and finalize outputs identical to a direct reference run of the same scripts on the same snapshot.
criteria: Settled iff all of: (1) the run was created by the scheduler (history shows scheduler trigger or the run exists without any manual `dagu start`); (2) history status aborted after stop and all observed owned processes exited; (3) retry uses the same run id and history reports succeeded; (4) checkpoint claim/count stays 1 and checkpoint bytes unchanged (model called exactly once, detected by an exclusive per-call claim file that a second call would fail to create); (5) validate and build_ecosystem --check outputs from the workflow equal the direct reference outputs; (6) the model step returned a verdict and a usage object. Any failure is recorded as not_settled/advanced with the observation.
